area: card-art / prism bake / clip audit harness
summary: The Regatta course genome (#2036) made SpawnableRegattaRails read new Regatta files, which broke the shared harness's compile. Added those sources to render_card_backgrounds.SOURCES and shimmed what they call (TextAsset, Resources.Load, AddComponent(Type), DestroyImmediate, PrismLayoutBake.Bypass; SpawnableBase.InvalidateCache made public in the shim, as it is in the game). bake_prism_layouts --check compiles again; it still reports Harvest and Shatterplane bakes stale from their own Nov changes.
